Start.Name: original_01_9be3d7d68cb4
Start.Text:
小初华！我说『小祥子就拜托你了』的时候，
你不是笑得很开心吗？

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_02_original_04_24d5df6f02a9
l2d_voice#2.Text: ！ 不要不要不要，给我停下！！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_04_adv_voice_mygo_001_1_17_037
l2d_voice#2.Text: 爽世她……不知该如何是好了

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_05_adv_voice_mujica_002_1_04_001
l2d_voice#2.Text: （不能失败……不许退缩—— 哈啊……哈啊……）

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_07_original_08_889832a84ed2
l2d_voice#2.Text: 你也好好看看我啊！听我说话啊！

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_08_original_09_22afc74acaa0
l2d_voice#2.Text: 你甚至不会察觉，自己陷入了沉眠

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_09_original_06_1fee7042b09a
l2d_voice#2.Text: 小睦和我，都是众多角色之中的一个

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_10_adv_voice_mujica_002_1_04_054
l2d_voice#2.Text: 『就像这样，小睦一直以来都不太会说话』

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_11_original_05_abc2efc1266f
l2d_voice#2.Text: 小睦真不懂事。 要我说几次你才明白啊

l2d_voice#2.Name: curated_12_original_03_a37a0620252f
l2d_voice#2.Text: 为什么会变成这样？ 我不是跟大家都聊过了吗？
